check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm PostgreSQL packages were installed only from organization-approved repositories (dnf/apt repo list + package From-repo). Record evidence.
Confirm only required PostgreSQL packages are installed (no unused admin UIs / docs packages beyond policy). Record package inventory.

check_definition.command: systemctl is-enabled postgresql-18.service 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-enabled postgresql.service 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-enabled postgresql@18-main.service 2>/dev/null
check_definition.fail_message: PostgreSQL systemd unit is not enabled.

windows_winrm.command: $s = Get-Service -Name 'postgresql*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $s) { 'missing' } elseif ($s.StartType -eq 'Automatic') { 'enabled' } else { $s.StartType }
windows_winrm.pass_message: PostgreSQL Windows service StartType is Automatic.
windows_winrm.fail_message: PostgreSQL Windows service is missing or not Automatic.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm the data cluster was initialized successfully (PGDATA exists, permissions private to the service account, initdb checksumming per policy).
Compare SHOW server_version against current PostgreSQL security releases and confirm the instance is on a supported, patched minor release.

check_definition.pass_message: PGPASSWORD is not set in user profiles.
check_definition.fail_message: PGPASSWORD appears in a user profile or /etc/environment.

check_definition.pass_message: No process environ currently exposes PGPASSWORD (readable /proc).
check_definition.fail_message: At least one process environ contains PGPASSWORD.

check_definition.pass_message: Current shell umask is 0077 or more restrictive.
check_definition.fail_message: Current shell umask is weaker than 0077.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm the PostgreSQL extension directory ownership/permissions match policy (typically root:root, mode 755). Use pg_config --sharedir/extension.

windows_winrm.command: $p = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $p) { 'no-install' } else { $ext = Join-Path $p.FullName 'share\extension'; if (-not (Test-Path $ext)) { 'missing-ext' } else { (Get-Acl $ext).Access | Out-String } }
windows_winrm.pass_message: PostgreSQL extension directory is present (review ACL in evidence).
windows_winrm.fail_message: PostgreSQL install/extension directory not found for ACL review.
windows_winrm._note: ACL detail is in raw output for operator review; tighten expect once policy is fixed.

check_definition.command: sh -c 'find /home /root -name .psql_history 2>/dev/null | while read f; do ls -la "$f"; done'
check_definition.pass_message: No regular .psql_history files found (only absences or /dev/null links).
check_definition.fail_message: A regular .psql_history file exists (should be absent or linked to /dev/null).

check_definition.pass_message: No password= entries found in checked pg_service files.
check_definition.fail_message: A password= entry was found in a pg_service file.

check_definition.sql: SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_destination'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'logging_collector'
SELECT current_setting('log_directory')
SELECT current_setting('log_filename')
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_file_mode'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_truncate_on_rotation'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_rotation_age'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_rotation_size'
SELECT CASE WHEN current_setting('log_destination', true) NOT ILIKE '%syslog%' THEN 'ok' WHEN lower(COALESCE(current_setting('syslog_facility', true),'')) ~ '^local[0-7]$' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END
check_definition.pass_message: syslog_facility is appropriate (or syslog logging is unused).
check_definition.fail_message: syslog is enabled but syslog_facility is not LOCAL0–LOCAL7.

check_definition.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN current_setting('log_destination', true) NOT ILIKE '%syslog%' THEN 'ok' WHEN lower(current_setting('syslog_sequence_numbers', true)) = 'on' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END
check_definition.fail_message: syslog is enabled but syslog_sequence_numbers is off.

check_definition.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN current_setting('log_destination', true) NOT ILIKE '%syslog%' THEN 'ok' WHEN lower(current_setting('syslog_split_messages', true)) = 'on' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END
check_definition.fail_message: syslog is enabled but syslog_split_messages is off.

check_definition.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN current_setting('log_destination', true) NOT ILIKE '%syslog%' THEN 'ok' WHEN length(COALESCE(current_setting('syslog_ident', true),'')) > 0 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END
check_definition.fail_message: syslog is enabled but syslog_ident is empty.

check_definition.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN lower(setting) IN ('warning','error','log','fatal','panic') THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_min_messages'
check_definition.fail_message: log_min_messages is below warning (too verbose / under-logging).

check_definition.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN lower(setting) IN ('error','log','fatal','panic') THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_min_error_statement'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'debug_print_parse'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'debug_print_rewritten'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'debug_print_plan'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'debug_pretty_print'
SELECT CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(setting,''),'off')) = 'on' THEN 'on' ELSE 'off' END FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_connections'
check_definition.fail_message: log_connections is OFF — connections are not audited.

check_definition.sql: SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_disconnections'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_error_verbosity'
SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_hostname'

SELECT CASE WHEN setting LIKE '%m%' AND setting LIKE '%p%' AND setting LIKE '%u%' AND setting LIKE '%d%' AND setting LIKE '%a%' AND setting LIKE '%h%' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_line_prefix'
check_definition.fail_message: log_line_prefix is missing one or more required tokens.

check_definition.sql: SELECT 1 FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_statement' AND lower(setting) <> 'none'
SELECT CASE WHEN upper(setting) IN ('GMT','UTC') OR setting ILIKE 'UTC%' OR setting ILIKE 'GMT%' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_timezone'
SELECT current_setting('shared_preload_libraries')
check_definition.fail_message: pgAudit is NOT loaded — no statement-level audit trail.

check_definition.pass_message: postgres OS account shell is non-interactive.
check_definition.fail_message: postgres OS account has an interactive login shell.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm only authorized OS admins can sudo -iu postgres (sudoers / group membership). Attest the approved admin list.

check_definition.sql: SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolsuper AND rolcanlogin AND rolname !~ '^pg_' ORDER BY 1 OFFSET 1
check_definition.pass_message: At most one login-capable superuser role (bootstrap owner).
check_definition.fail_message: Multiple login-capable superuser roles — revoke excess admin privileges.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Review pg_roles WHERE rolcanlogin and confirm inactive human/service accounts are NOLOGIN. Automated listing alone cannot know 'currently unused'.

check_definition.sql: SELECT n.nspname || '.' || p.proname FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE p.prosecdef AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND p.proname NOT LIKE 'pgaudit%'
check_definition.pass_message: No non-catalog SECURITY DEFINER functions found.
check_definition.fail_message: SECURITY DEFINER functions exist outside system catalogs — review necessity.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Inventory table DML grants (pg_tables × role grants) per database and confirm only authorized roles hold INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.
Confirm every table that requires RLS has relrowsecurity enabled and policies applied (business-process decision; cannot auto-pass).

check_definition.sql: SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'set_user'

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Review superuser roles and confirm predefined roles (pg_monitor, pg_read_all_settings, …) are used instead of blanket SUPERUSER where possible.

check_definition.sql: SELECT rolname FROM pg_authid WHERE rolpassword IS NULL AND rolcanlogin AND rolname !~ '^pg_'
check_definition.pass_message: All login roles have a password set (or none can login without one).
check_definition.fail_message: Login roles without passwords exist — use passwords or cert auth intentionally.
check_definition._note: Needs rights to read pg_authid; otherwise the check errors (not auto-pass).

check_definition.command: sh -c 'ps -eww -o args= 2>/dev/null | grep -E "psql|postgres://" | grep -i password | grep -v grep | head -n 5 || true'
check_definition.pass_message: No live process args expose a password= / postgres URI password.
check_definition.fail_message: A process command line appears to embed a database password.

check_definition.sql: SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'listen_addresses'
check_definition.pass_message: listen_addresses is bound to specific host(s), not '*'.
check_definition.fail_message: listen_addresses is '*' — the DB accepts connections on every interface.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Attest local (UNIX socket) pg_hba rules: peer for postgres only as intended; other OS users cannot impersonate DB roles over the socket.

check_definition.sql: SELECT type || ' ' || array_to_string(database, ',') || ' ' || array_to_string(user_name, ',') || ' ' || COALESCE(address,'') || ' ' || auth_method FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE type IN ('host','hostssl','hostnossl') AND auth_method IN ('trust','password')
check_definition.pass_message: No host TCP rules use trust or plaintext password auth.
check_definition.fail_message: One or more host TCP pg_hba rules use trust or password (use scram-sha-256/cert/etc).

check_definition.sql: SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND rolcanlogin AND rolconnlimit = -1
check_definition.pass_message: All login roles have a finite connection limit.
check_definition.fail_message: One or more login roles have rolconnlimit = -1 (unlimited).

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm password complexity (e.g. passwordcheck / policy) meets organization requirements — not fully expressible as a single cluster setting.
Document understood attack vectors and which runtime parameters are intentionally tunable by non-superusers vs locked down.

check_definition.sql: SELECT name FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('debug_print_parse','debug_print_rewritten','debug_print_plan') AND lower(setting) = 'on'
check_definition.fail_message: One or more backend debug_print_* parameters are on.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Review Postmaster-context parameters (listen_addresses, port, shared_buffers, shared_preload_libraries) against hardened baseline; attest.
Review SIGHUP-reloadable parameters against hardened baseline; attest.
Review Superuser-context parameters against hardened baseline; attest.
Review User-context parameters and ALTER ROLE/USER SETs for unsafe overrides; attest.
Confirm FIPS 140-2 OpenSSL cryptography is in use where policy requires it.

check_definition.sql: SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'ssl'

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(current_setting('ssl_min_protocol_version'),'') = '' THEN 'ok' WHEN current_setting('ssl_min_protocol_version') !~* 'TLSv1(\.0|\.1)(,|$)' AND current_setting('ssl_min_protocol_version') !~* '(^|,)TLSv1(,|$)' THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END
check_definition.pass_message: ssl_min_protocol_version excludes TLSv1.0/1.1 (or unset with modern default).

check_definition.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(current_setting('ssl_ciphers'),'') = '' THEN 'ok' WHEN current_setting('ssl_ciphers') ~* '(NULL|EXP|aNULL|ADH|RC4|DES|MD5)' THEN 'bad' ELSE 'ok' END
check_definition.pass_message: ssl_ciphers does not list known-weak suites.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm pgcrypto is installed where required and configured per policy (extension present + key management practices).
Confirm a replication-only role (REPLICATION, NOSUPERUSER) is used for streaming replication — not a superuser.

check_definition.sql: SELECT setting FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'log_replication_commands'

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm base backups are configured, scheduled, and restore-tested.

check_definition.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN lower(setting) IN ('on','always') THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'archive_mode'
check_definition.fail_message: archive_mode is off — WAL archiving not enabled.

check_definition.attestation_prompt: Confirm streaming replication parameters (primary_conninfo, slots, sync commit) match the intended topology.
Confirm tablespace / log / archive directories live outside the data cluster directory as required by policy.
Confirm pgBackRest (or approved backup tool) is installed and configured.
Review miscellaneous configuration settings against the organization's hardened baseline and attest.
